subject: CS471
filterSummary: Successfully selected 4 English and 3 Arabic videos. Coverage was strong for most topics, with high-quality, relevant videos available for multi-tenancy, edge/fog computing, and IoT security in both languages. The OpenStack Keystone topic lacked Arabic candidates. The highly specific 'MiniSec' topic had no candidates in either language, which was expected given the search results.
